name: One Life
detailed_description:
ONE LIFE is a groundbreaking open-world multiplayer survival game that merges photorealistic visuals with dynamic gameplay. Set in a vast and intricately designed world, players will engage in an immersive experience where melee combat, magic abilities, and a flight system are at the core of exploration and combat. Players can enjoy a multitude of features such as GASP Locomotion, In-game text chat with friends, Game Settings, Advanced customization, Skills Tree & Leveling, Versatile Combat, Ranged Weapons, Magic & Spells, Throwing Objects, Remote Bomb & Detonator, Traps & Landing Mines, Advanced Ability & Damage Systems, Quests, Crafting, Modular snapping building, Locking & Claim Systems, Fishing System, Gardening & Farming, Animals & Breeding, Emotion System, Vehicles, Advanced AI, AI Companions & Orders, NPC Trading & Player Respawn, Advanced Inventory & Crafting, Resource Mining, Loot System, and much more!

The game offers a diverse array of biomes, each with its own distinct seasonal weather patterns, creating a living, breathing environment that evolves over time. Players can traverse these environments, leveraging flight capabilities to uncover hidden areas and strategies for survival. The seamless blend of natural and fantastical elements enhances the world’s depth, encouraging exploration and discovery.

At its heart, ONE LIFE is a survival experience where players face off against each other in fast-paced, strategic combat while balancing the opportunity to forge alliances. Teams can unite to take on formidable bosses and colossal giants, combining skills and strategies to overcome challenges.

Inspired by critically acclaimed titles such as Sekiro and Elden Ring, ONE LIFE combines high-intensity action with intricate world-building. The combat system integrates visceral melee engagements with powerful magic-based abilities, offering players a variety of playstyles to master. The addition of a flight system introduces innovative vertical gameplay, allowing players to explore the world and gain tactical advantages.

Whether fighting for survival, forging alliances, or battling towering enemies, ONE LIFE promises to deliver an unparalleled multiplayer survival experience that redefines the genre. The combination of stunning visuals, dynamic gameplay systems, and a richly diverse world positions ONE LIFE as a standout title in the gaming landscape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated, Dedicated
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Ray tracing will likely be disabled, and the game will run on lower graphical settings like Medium or Low. Multiplayer will work, but some performance drops might occur in large open-world environments
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-13900K / AMD Ryzen 9 7900X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4080 / AMD RX 7900 XTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated, Dedicated
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Multiplayer and ray tracing at Epic settings, high-quality textures, and ultra settings
